SpecialTraits.Floating Dread (Aura): Emits soft, mournful moans in a 30-ft radius. Creatures starting their turn in the aura must make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or suffer disadvantage on Insight and Perception checks for 1 hour. Immunity on a successful save for 24 hours.
SpecialTraits.Neurosporic Burst (1/Day): When reduced to 0 HP, explodes in a 10-ft radius cloud of spores. Creatures must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 round and affected by hallucinatory terrain (self-targeted) for 1 minute (save ends each turn). On a success, take 2d6 psychic damage and no further effect.
SpecialTraits.False Memory Infection (Optional): Failed saves to Neurosporic Burst may embed fragmented foreign memories. These may provide lore clues, false visions, or strange prophecies.

Actions.Lashing Tendril: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage. Target must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of its next turn.

Notes: The Hollow Wailcap is a spectral, floating fungus found in cursed forests, crypts, or deep caves. It feeds on emotion, regret, and latent psychic trauma, emitting empathic moans and hallucination-inducing spores. Its presence often heralds the remnants of sorrowful or long-forgotten events.
